description:
LUNARIS: Lunar Mission Intelligence System

LUNARIS is a proposed interactive lunar mission planning platform designed to help researchers, engineers, and space enthusiasts evaluate potential Moon landing sites using NASA's scientific data.

The system aims to analyze solar illumination, Earth visibility, and communication opportunities across different lunar locations and mission dates. Through interactive visualizations and computational analysis, users will be able to compare landing sites, identify potential operational constraints, and understand the factors influencing mission planning.

Our objective is to transform complex astronomical data into an accessible, scientifically grounded decision-support tool, making lunar exploration planning more intuitive, transparent, and efficient.
